subject: microbiology
title: Elek Gel Precipitation Test and Diphtheria Toxin Detection

steps.tx: The **Elek gel precipitation test** proves toxigenicity in vitro: a filter paper strip soaked in diphtheria antitoxin lies across an agar plate, test and control strains streaked perpendicularly, and after 24 to 48 hours toxin diffusing from producers meets antitoxin in precipitin lines (lines of identity with the known toxigenic control) at about 45 degrees.
steps.say: Toxin walks from the streak, antitoxin from the strip; their meeting line convicts the strain.

left.title: Elek setup
points: Elek agar with serum, low iron conditions
Positive and negative control strains flank

right.title: Elek reading
points: Line of identity merges with positive control

steps.tx: **Diphtheria toxin** itself (58 kilodalton AB protein) is cleaved into A (enzyme) and B (binding and translocation) linked by disulfide, B reading heparin binding EGF receptor on heart and nerve, A ADP ribosylating elongation factor 2 using NAD, one molecule per cell theoretically lethal. Formaldehyde converts it to toxoid without touching the gene story.
steps.say: B delivers, A poisons EF2: diphtheria toxin is the AB archetype every toxin lesson copies.

left.title: Toxin anatomy
points: Single polypeptide nicked to A plus B

right.title: Toxin fate
points: Heart and peripheral nerve most clinical

steps.tx: **Modified Elek and immunochromatography** accelerate proof (colony Elek in hours traditions, toxin ELISA and lateral flow), while **tox PCR** detects the gene in hours from isolates and sometimes directly, the pair answering different questions: capable (PCR) versus producing (Elek). Reports must state which was answered.
steps.say: PCR says capable, Elek says producing; reports confuse them at clinical peril.

right.title: Gene tests
points: Direct clinical specimen PCR by reference labs
Non toxigenic tox bearing strains described
Culture still required for Elek and epidemiology

steps.tx: **Antitoxin dosing logic** (equine DIP antitoxin by membrane extent and duration: pharyngeal small 20,000 to 40,000 units, nasopharyngeal higher, extensive or bull neck 80,000 to 120,000 traditions) follows toxin already fixed irreversibly, so site and delay, not weight, dominate; intravenous route after test dose, serum sickness counselled.
steps.say: Dose by membrane and delay, not weight; fixed toxin is beyond antitoxin's reach.

left.title: Dose strata
points: Limited pharyngeal under 48 hours: lower range
Extensive, bull neck, over 3 days: highest

right.title: Antitoxin discipline
points: Do not delay for transport of patient to results
Serum sickness follow up counselled (1 to 2 weeks)

steps.tx: **Myocarditis and neuropathy surveillance** after diphtheria (ECG serially, bed rest traditions, palatal and diaphragmatic weakness watch) follows toxin kinetics, steroid and pacing decisions cardiology guided, rehabilitation for neuropathy recovering over months usually. Discharge is a monitoring plan, not an ending.
steps.say: The throat heals first; ECG and palate declare toxin's later appointments.

right.title: Neuro watch
points: Palatal paralysis week 3 to 5 (nasal voice, regurgitation)

steps.tx: **Toxigenicity in ulcerans and pseudotuberculosis** (zoonotic Corynebacterium acquiring same phage) extends Elek beyond diphtheriae species: isolates from animal contacts with diphtheria like membrane are referred identically, pasteurised milk and pet and cattle histories matter, antitoxin indications equal. Species name never downgrades toxin suspicion.
steps.say: Ulcerans with toxin is diphtheria clinically, whatever the species label says.

left.title: Ulcerans reality
points: Cattle, raw milk, companion animal links
Now leads toxigenic isolates some countries

right.title: Bench response
points: All three species to reference for tox
Contact tracing includes animals rarely formally

steps.tx: **Elek quality and controls** (known toxigenic NCTC control, non toxigenic negative, strip potency, serum lot) teach immunodiffusion generally: precipitin lines of identity, partial identity spurs and non identity crossing from the Ouchterlony module return here with a patient's airway at stake.
steps.say: Controls merge or the test did not happen; precipitin grammar is Elek grammar.

right.title: Failure modes
points: Streaks too heavy or too close strip
Weak toxin after antibiotics in vivo still matters clinically

steps.tx: **Clinical versus laboratory hierarchy** must be restated: antitoxin is given on suspicion, antibiotics stop production, Elek and PCR confirm for epidemiology and contact decisions, negative tox in a classic case triggers reference review not reassurance theatre. Public health owns the penultimate word with the treating team.
steps.say: Confirm for contacts and records, never to permission to treat.

nodes.label: Confirm: PCR then Elek at reference
